tasks.description: Use a typed session-bound transport for the accepted routine soil-check reversal wire.
constraints: Return a valid unified Git diff with exact source context and proper separate diff headers in JSON. Controller applies and tests.

Exact accepted server wire: POST /commands, command_name=care.check_soil.undo, plant_id and operation_id in existing envelope. payload_json contains only entry_id UUID. Successful response has plant_id, task_id, entry_id, reversal_id UUIDs, state=voided and nonnegative SQL watermark; unrelated/malformed receipt must fail. Exact body and operation ID can be resent by caller. Reuse owner-bound SyncSessionLease auth, EN Accept-Language, and installation credential stripping from routine completion.

Prefer the existing dedicated approach to sending typed requests. Make unit tests verify the exact owner-bound request, valid receipt and at least mismatched receipt and non-voided rejection. Exclude outbox wiring, UI, real service, local persistence and watering and first-aid undo changes. Leave T160/T171 open.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unit gate passes with exact typed undo and owner-bound command coverage.
